base_style: High-contrast, hand-inked graphic novel style with an OSR (Old School Renaissance) aesthetic; Mignola-esque stark shadows, heavy solid blacks, and expressive linework with stippling for texture.
color_palette: Strictly monochrome; high-contrast black and white with no greyscale or mid-tones.
layout_and_composition: Multi-panel comic page featuring gritty stone blocks and Gothic arches; utilizes stark lighting and deep shadows to create a humorous TTRPG dungeon crawl atmosphere.
lettering_and_dialog: Hand-drawn speech bubbles containing deadpan dialogue; includes a small narrative box at the bottom of the page.
text_rendering_guide: Dialogue: bold hand-drawn rounded bubbles with thick borders and expressive placement. Captions: solid black rectangles with white text, bottom of panel. Voice Over: shaded speech bubbles, softer edges, top-right. Chyrons: white text on black bar, bottom-center. Sound Effects: bold, blocky letters in burst shapes.
